meta.name: muapi-seedance-2
meta.description: Expert Cinema Director skill for Seedance 2.0 (ByteDance) — high-fidelity video generation across Chinese, Global, and VIP tiers. Supports text-to-video, image-to-video, first-last-frame, omni reference, character training, omni-reference training, video editing, and watermark removal.

copy.tagline: 用文字或图片生成高质量视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用AI生成或编辑视频
copy.tagline_en: Generate high-fidelity videos from text or images
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need AI-powered video generation and editing

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能根据你的文字描述或图片生成 4-15 秒的高质量视频，支持多种模式：文字转视频、图片转视频、首尾帧插值、视频编辑、去水印等。
howto.when: 当你提供视频创意描述、上传图片或视频，并指定生成模式（如文字转视频、图片转视频）时触发。

say.text: 用这张照片生成一段 10 秒的慢动作视频，背景音乐用钢琴曲。
say.note: Claude 会调用图片转视频模式，生成带指定音乐的视频。

say.text: 把这段视频延长 5 秒，保持原有风格。
say.note: Claude 会使用视频扩展模式，在末尾追加内容。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate 4-15 second high-quality videos from text descriptions or images, supporting text-to-video, image-to-video, first-last-frame interpolation, video editing, and watermark removal.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide a video idea, upload images/videos, and specify a generation mode (e.g., text-to-video, image-to-video).

say_en.text: Generate a 10-second slow-motion video from this photo with piano background music.
say_en.note: Claude will use image-to-video mode with specified music.

say_en.text: Extend this video by 5 seconds while keeping the original style.
say_en.note: Claude will use video extension mode to append content.
